column1: # manifests/forky-snapshot.tsv -- the immutable root of trust for the BUILD pin.
# The provenance gate verifies the signed Debian Release (InRelease) for exactly this
# snapshot against the committed keyring and these committed digests. A cache that does
# not verify against THIS file is rejected; a self-written stamp is not verification.
# key<TAB>value.  Update ONLY with a reviewed re-pin (build/pin-forky-snapshot.sh) plus a
# fresh keyring/signature check -- never to make a failing gate pass.
# di_suite: the SAME pinned snapshot's development suite (sid/unstable).  The Debian
# netinst substrate ships debian-installer udebs built from sid, while its base packages
# are testing (forky).  A snapshot.debian.org timestamp is the whole archive state, so
# the gate reads forky's full index set AND sid's debian-installer indexes -- the same
# snapshot, the same keyring, one Debian origin (NOT a fourth origin), and never sid's
# runtime (binary-*) packages.  di_inrelease_* is the digest of dists/sid/InRelease at
# the pinned timestamp; build/refresh-substrate.sh records/verifies it.
